import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        print(0)
        return
    
    n = int(data[0])
    if n == 0:
        print(0)
        return
    
    arr = list(map(int, data[1:n+1]))
    
    odds = []
    evens = []
    
    for num in arr:
        if num % 2 == 1:
            odds.append(num)
        else:
            evens.append(num)
    
    required_odds = n // 2
    required_evens = n // 2
    
    current_odds = len(odds)
    current_evens = len(evens)
    
    need_odds = required_odds - current_odds
    need_evens = required_evens - current_evens
    
    total_cost = 0
    
    if need_odds > 0:
        evens.sort()
        for i in range(need_odds):
            num = evens[i]
            cost_to_make_odd = num + 1 if num % 2 == 0 else 1
            total_cost += num + 1 - num
    
    if need_evens > 0:
        odds.sort()
        for i in range(need_evens):
            num = odds[len(odds) - 1 - i]
            cost_to_make_even = num + 1 if num % 2 == 1 else 1
            total_cost += 1
    
    print(total_cost)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
